findings.title: Mutations remain unguarded by `requirePermission` in several routers (including a governance state transition)
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: governance submit is guarded (routes/governance.ts:190-218) and client-onboarding mutations are guarded, but the residual set is unchanged: routes/projects.ts:869,934,971,1010,1039,1084,1185,1220,1252 (task comments, updates, task read/approve/portal-comment) and routes/assets.ts:376 and routes/findings.ts:478 carry only org scoping (assertProjectInOrg/loadOwned), no requirePermission. No new unguarded route was added in this diff.

findings.title: External integration syncs report success while dropping items, and `jsm-sync` has no HTTP retry
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: jsm-sync.ts:230-234 returns ok:false when any ticket fails and retries transient HTTP (:39-46); stripe-reconcile.ts fails the run on drift/per-item errors; jira-sync.ts still increments errors at :114-122 and :184 but returns { ok: true } at :206 after logging the error count.

findings.title: Published error-handling contract contradicts the implementation (codes, 422, and `request_id`)
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: docs/API_ERROR_HANDLING.md:19-67 documents the implemented flat envelope, 400-not-422 validation and X-Request-ID header; middleware/request-id.ts:18 emits the header and middleware/error.ts maps Zod to 400 VALIDATION.

findings.title: SDK retries unsafe requests without an `Idempotency-Key` (duplicate creates on transient failure)
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: packages/sdk/src/client.ts:213-220 mints one Idempotency-Key per logical request outside executeFetch's retry loop, and :337-341 does the same for uploads.

findings.title: Outbound webhook dispatcher uses a non-atomic idempotency check (duplicate deliveries under concurrency)
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: apps/api/src/lib/webhook-dispatcher.ts:203-206 atomically claims per endpoint before sending and upserts the delivery row on idempotency_key (:23-40); apps/worker/src/tasks/webhook-dispatcher.ts:111-127 mirrors the claim; the concurrent-duplicate tests remain.

findings.title: Search falls through to an unscoped cross-tenant query
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: routes/search.ts:95-128 derives scopedOrgIds from req.orgScope, substitutes ['__none__'] for an empty scope, and only grants the all-tenant branch to a verified super_admin holding a cross-tenant role; search-portal.ts:45-66 scopes to approved memberships.

findings.title: OpenAPI schema is public and the Swagger UI is blocked by CSP
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: routes/docs.ts:21-39 returns 404 for /openapi.json and /docs when NODE_ENV=production; the nonce/SRI wiring remains; node scripts/openapi-audit.js -> exit 0 with 0 MISSING.

findings.title: Minor contract inconsistencies (`rateLimitByUser` non-enveloped 429, capped raw-array lists, no `request_id`)
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: the 429 gap is fixed - every limiter uses rateLimitHandler -> failure('RATE_LIMITED',...) (middleware/rate-limit.ts:15,27-31). Residual: idempotency middleware still returns {error: string} for the 400 overlong key (middleware/idempotency.ts:30) and {error: string, idempotencyKey} for 409 (:69-73), and request-timeout returns {error:{code,message}} without success/status (middleware/request-timeout.ts:37-41), while docs/API_ERROR_HANDLING.md:19-30 says every handled error uses the flat envelope.

findings.title: OpenAPI artifact is not bound to a commit and the CI audit warns (not fails) on documented-but-missing routes
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: scripts/openapi-audit.js now fails on any EXTRA route not in scripts/openapi-audit-allowlist.json (ran: 455 live routes vs 697 spec entries, 0 MISSING, 242 EXTRA all allow-listed, exit 0). Residual: docs/openapi.yaml:1-4 still names only the generator, with no commit SHA or migrations digest, so the artifact is not bound to the source it was generated from.

findings.title: Realtime client has no reconnect path; server emits `auth_expired` with no documented client handling
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: apps/web/components/NotificationBell.tsx:112-188 implements bounded exponential-backoff reconnect with a fallback poller and treats auth_expired as terminal -> sign-in.

findings.title: `/metrics` is fully public when `METRICS_TOKEN` is unset
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: apps/api/src/app.ts:152-165 returns 404 unless authorizeInternalRequest(req, METRICS_TOKEN) succeeds; an unset token fails closed.

findings.title: Batch Jira/JSM/M365 sync tasks are registered but never dispatched (no scheduler or enqueue path)
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: routes/admin.ts:127-169 POST /admin/integration-syncs enqueues jira/jsm/m365 tasks behind a super-admin check and returns 503 when the queue is unavailable.

findings.title: M365 calendar sync recreates a calendar event for every task on each run (duplicate events, no idempotency)
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: apps/worker/src/tasks/m365-calendar-sync.ts:103-139 PATCHes the persisted m365_event_id and stores new ids; the schema column is 5302455.

findings.title: M365 inbound webhook acknowledges but only processes the first notification of a batch
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: routes/webhooks.ts:920-982 iterates every notification in value[], with per-notification clientState, dedup/audit/delivery logging.

findings.title: GET /dynamic-forms/export.csv ignores format and returns JSON, contradicting the OpenAPI contract
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: the route now emits real CSV via sendExportResponse (routes/dynamic-client-forms-builder.ts:86-110) and the OpenAPI summary says CSV, so the 'returns JSON' half is fixed. Residual: `format` is still accepted and ignored - the route always sends CSV even when `format=json` is requested (validators/dynamic-client-forms-builder.ts:65-70 passes parsed.format into services/dynamic-client-forms-builder.ts:327-356, which discards it), while the SDK still advertises ExportDynamicFormsSchema format csv|json (packages/sdk/src/dynamic-client-forms-builder.ts:92-97, .api.ts:90-96 sends it). No web call site; latent contract break for SDK consumers.

report: Read-only re-verification at 6b7aa1a5; no live API calls. 10 of 15 previous API rows verified fixed, 5 partially fixed, 0 regressed, 0 new (the new proposal client-decision contract gap is tracked cross-domain as ADMIN-P2-010 and is not re-scored here).
